name: Assign owner with rotation override
rule: Next-up is preselected; picking anyone else requires an override reason, which is audited.
acceptance: Commit is disabled until a reason is chosen when the pick isn't next-up.

name: Close with reason
rule: Ending a record requires a reason from a fixed list plus an optional note; the result is logged as an exit or audit.
acceptance: Commit is disabled until a reason is chosen; the exit appears in reporting.

name: Move between stages, with an alternative to dragging
rule: Dragging and a Move to… dialog do the same thing; a 6s Undo follows.
acceptance: Moving without dragging works at 390px; Undo restores the previous stage and timer.

name: Manager-only discipline
rule: Only a manager can bench or un-bench; a coaching note is required and is visible to manager, GM and admin only.
acceptance: Non-managers see the control disabled with a note saying who can.

name: Request instead of act
rule: Roles with approve access create a request; the approver confirms; the state doesn't change until then.
acceptance: The requester sees 'request sent'; the approver sees a queue item.

name: Pause with fulfilment check
rule: Pausing needs a reason and a duration; unpausing needs confirmation that the reason is fulfilled.
acceptance: Unpause stays disabled until the check is ticked.

name: Multi-step intake with lookup
rule: Look up an existing record first; walk-in is the fallback; the match pre-fills names; a new profile is created after intake.
acceptance: A 10-digit phone number returns a match or a warning; walk-in skips lookup.

name: Inspect-and-return detail
rule: Detail opens in a side sheet (a bottom sheet on phone) without leaving the list.
acceptance: The list stays visible behind the sheet; Escape closes it and returns focus.

name: Live counts and timers
rule: Counts and timers are worked out on the client from timestamps and tick every second; the server stays the source of truth.
acceptance: A timer advances without reloading; the count equals the list length.

name: Tracked commit
rule: Every commit emits a named event with its payload.
acceptance: The event fires once per commit, with actor, role and store.
